    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Merge_Intl" name="Visa step done"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Merge_Semester_U" name="Semester start"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PostGrades" name="Post grades"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Split_Appeal" name="Appeal filed?" default="Flow_NoAppeal"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocsComplete" sourceRef="Split_Docs" targetRef="Par_Split_Eval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U4" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMissing" targetRef="Catch_DocsProvided"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U5" sourceRef="Catch_DocsProvided" targetRef="Merge_Review"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U6" sourceRef="Par_Split_Eval" targetRef="Task_Evaluate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U7" sourceRef="Par_Split_Eval" targetRef="Task_ProcessFee"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U8" sourceRef="Task_Evaluate" targetRef="Par_Join_Eval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U9" sourceRef="Task_ProcessFee" targetRef="Par_Join_Eval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U10" sourceRef="Par_Join_Eval" targetRef="Split_Decision"/>

      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${applicationAccepted}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejected" sourceRef="Split_Decision" targetRef="Task_SendReject"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U11" sourceRef="Task_SendReject" targetRef="End_Univ_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U12" sourceRef="Task_SendAccept" targetRef="EBG_Confirm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U13" sourceRef="EBG_Confirm" targetRef="Catch_Confirm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U14" sourceRef="EBG_Confirm" targetRef="Catch_DeadlinePassed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U15" sourceRef="Catch_DeadlinePassed" targetRef="Task_CancelApp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U16" sourceRef="Task_CancelApp" targetRef="End_Univ_Canceled"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U18" sourceRef="Par_Split_Confirmed" targetRef="Task_SendOrientation"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U21" sourceRef="Task_SetupAccounts" targetRef="Par_Join_Setup"/>

    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInternational" sourceRef="Split_International" targetRef="Merge_Intl"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U23" sourceRef="Task_VisaProcessing" targetRef="Merge_Intl"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U24" sourceRef="Merge_Intl" targetRef="Merge_Semester_U"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U25" sourceRef="Merge_Semester_U" targetRef="Task_PostGrades"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U26" sourceRef="Task_PostGrades" targetRef="Split_Appeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AppealFiled" sourceRef="Split_Appeal" targetRef="Catch_AppealForm">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${hasGrievance}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAppeal" sourceRef="Split_Appeal" targetRef="Merge_Appeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U27" sourceRef="Catch_AppealForm" targetRef="Task_AppealCommittee"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U28" sourceRef="Task_AppealCommittee" targetRef="Task_AppealDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U29" sourceRef="Task_AppealDecision" targetRef="Merge_Appeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U30" sourceRef="Merge_Appeal" targetRef="Split_Repeat_U"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Graduated_U" sourceRef="Split_Repeat_U" targetRef="End_Univ_Done">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${graduatedOrWithdrawn}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Continue_U" sourceRef="Split_Repeat_U" targetRef="Merge_Semester_U"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendAccept</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendReject</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Univ_Rejected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_DeadlinePassed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CancelApp</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Univ_Canceled</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendOrientation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Split_International</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Merge_Semester_U</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_SemesterEnd</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PostGrades</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_AppealForm</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Merge_Appeal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Split_Repeat_U</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecordGraduation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecordWithdrawal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Univ_Graduated</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessFee</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_IT" name="IT Department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetupAccounts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_VisaProcessing</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Univ" name="Application received">

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Par_Join_Setup" name="Onboarding done"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Split_Repeat_U" name="Graduated or withdrawn?" default="Flow_Continue_U"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordWithdrawal" name="Record withdrawal"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Univ_Withdrawn" name="Student withdrew"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocsComplete" sourceRef="Split_Docs" targetRef="Par_Split_Eval"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U5" sourceRef="Catch_DocsProvided" targetRef="Merge_Review"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U9" sourceRef="Task_ProcessFee" targetRef="Par_Join_Eval"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U16" sourceRef="Task_CancelApp" targetRef="End_Univ_Canceled"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U17" sourceRef="Catch_Confirm" targetRef="Par_Split_Confirmed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U18" sourceRef="Par_Split_Confirmed" targetRef="Task_SendOrientation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U19" sourceRef="Par_Split_Confirmed" targetRef="Task_SetupAccounts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U20" sourceRef="Task_SendOrientation" targetRef="Par_Join_Setup"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U21" sourceRef="Task_SetupAccounts" targetRef="Par_Join_Setup"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U22" sourceRef="Par_Join_Setup" targetRef="Split_International"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_International" sourceRef="Split_International" targetRef="Task_VisaProcessing">

      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${grievanceFiled}</bpmn:conditionExpression>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U32" sourceRef="Task_RecordGraduation" targetRef="End_Univ_Graduated"/>
